comment: Patches of the pinned UniXNU queue that are deliberately not applied to Darwin22. Each entry records why. They are not replaced by a fake no-op: the staging script removes them from the build queue.

patches.offline-owner-systemos-mount.patch: Owner-project SystemOS cache mount (XNU_OWNER_* APFS UUIDs, dyld preboot cache). Not part of the first sweet bring-up, which mounts the existing HFS+ root. Needs a full Darwin22 rewrite, not a context fix.
patches.pgz-aligned-validation.patch: Patches zone_id_require_aligned(), which does not exist in XNU 8796. Darwin23-only hardening; not required to build or boot.
patches.public-entitlements-header.patch: Switches CodeSignature/Entitlements.h to CoreEntitlements, which Darwin22 does not use. Darwin23-only source layout.
patches.published-freezer-condition.patch: Edits FREEZE_ENABLED_DEFAULT, absent from XNU 8796. Darwin23-only memorystatus code.
patches.zzy-native-gpu-addon-mount.patch: Depends on the offline-owner kern_exec.c context (SystemOS cache mount). Deferred with that feature.
patches.zzx-pmap-sync-64bit-pa.patch: Edits osfmk/arm64/sptm/pmap/pmap.c; SPTM does not exist in Darwin22.
patches.zzz-boot-progress.patch: Depends on the offline-owner kern_exec.c context and Darwin23 sleh.c/Makefile layout. Optional observation layer; deferred.
